scope: Independent full pass over all 63 ui.console keys at the current bytes: read en/ui.console.json and en/ui.console.context.json, console-states.tsx (ended banner) and console-pane.tsx (tab strip), the core glossary and locale style guides, and docs/I18N.md; checked accuracy, register, glossary consistency, placeholder/ICU integrity, CLDR plurals, ur RTL and cell widths. No catalogue, ledger or code changes.

findings.issue: "बंद किया गया" uses the pane's close-action verb (close.confirm "टर्मिनल बंद करें") for a signalled kill, while the ended state in this namespace is "समाप्त"; it reads "closed by SIGKILL" rather than killed.
findings.suggestion: {signal} से समाप्त किया गया (25 cells, two more than the current 23)

findings.issue: The two बंद forms two words apart mirror "the app closed it when it quit" word for word; "ऐप ने बंद होते समय इसे समाप्त किया" keeps the app as the actor without the repetition.
findings.suggestion: ऐप ने बंद होते समय इसे समाप्त किया (33 cells, two more than the current 31)
